entries.subject: Button component-local styles
entries.behavior: Extract Button owner CSS, bounded attribute/native pseudo selectors and caller composition from the global css intrinsic without runtime object authoring or scanning.

entries.subject: Button automatic stylesheet adoption
entries.behavior: Adopt the exact compiled Button stylesheet once per Document and make it visible to every same-Document projection without manual buttonCss or consumer styleSheets wiring.

entries.subject: ColorPickerField
entries.behavior: Stable controlled RGBA values with retained HSVA number/range input/change semantics and analytical color paint.

entries.subject: ColorField
entries.behavior: An anchored top-layer color picker with clipping, light dismiss, Escape and focus restoration instead of an inline hidden panel.

entries.subject: NumberField
entries.behavior: Native typed number editing, focus, input/change, Escape rollback and selection through the exact semantic owner.

entries.subject: NumberField scrub
entries.behavior: A scrub gesture continues outside the control until pointerup/cancel without component-owned capture emulation.

entries.subject: CodeEditor
entries.behavior: Two-axis scrolling with clipping and stable retained line/token identity.

entries.subject: CodeEditor
entries.behavior: Preserve source whitespace and prevent wrapping for read-only code lines.

entries.subject: aggregate overview cross-axis packing
entries.behavior: Keep wrapped aggregate rows compact at flex cross-start inside the remaining-height grid instead of inheriting the standard stretching default.

entries.subject: aggregate overview packing
entries.behavior: Pack aggregate category and subject cards on shared flex lines while space remains, then move later cards to following lines without consumer-owned coordinates.

entries.subject: Inspector numeric fields
entries.behavior: Focused numeric field editing inside nested scrollable Inspector groups.

entries.subject: SourceEditor
entries.behavior: Keep semantic textarea selection start/end/direction synchronized with the editable source.

entries.subject: SourceEditor
entries.behavior: Paint a visible caret and selected range aligned with the separately tokenized presentation.

entries.subject: SourceEditor scrollToLine
entries.behavior: Use current rendered line geometry instead of a hard-coded line height and viewport.

entries.subject: SourceEditor
entries.behavior: Copy/cut/paste the current source selection through the browser host without a component-local clipboard dispatcher.

entries.subject: SelectField
entries.behavior: Open a collapsed select picker, navigate retained options by keyboard, activate one option and dispatch change.

entries.subject: NodeTree
entries.behavior: Retain node, link, parameter and socket identity across high-volume topology and parameter updates.

entries.subject: Parameter external store
entries.behavior: Observe topology/parameter snapshots without duplicating the canonical Node store.

entries.subject: Link
entries.behavior: Present routed links and grid primitives without decomposing them into component-owned rectangles and points.

entries.subject: NodeEditor
entries.behavior: Pan/zoom reaches paint, clip and inverse hit consistently for the graph surface.

entries.subject: NodeEditor grid and links
entries.behavior: Scale grid and routed connection presentation without a local DOM geometry renderer.

entries.subject: FileTree
entries.behavior: Expose tree rows, level, expansion and selection through the semantic accessibility mapping.

entries.subject: Terminal
entries.behavior: Route focused text entry, keyboard control sequences and composition into the semantic terminal input owner.

entries.subject: Terminal selection
entries.behavior: Retain and expose terminal text selection for copy instead of returning a fabricated null snapshot.

entries.subject: Module displays
entries.behavior: Project every module root from one shared Experience Document into stable world planes with nearest-plane input, resize, capture and cleanup.

entries.subject: Interpreter presentation host
entries.behavior: Own one semantic Document, Canvas, Engine Renderer and Space for all module display roots in the Interpreter Experience.

entries.subject: Bulk DOM overlay
entries.behavior: Compose the HUD through the shared browser overlay owner rather than reimplementing pointer mapping, capture, hit and lifecycle.

entries.subject: Cosmos display plane
entries.behavior: Attach the Cosmos main root from the shared Experience Document to a stable world plane with the intended stylesheet and camera gestures.

entries.subject: Cosmos display dock
entries.behavior: Attach the dock sibling root from the same Experience Document to a camera-locked overlay using the host stylesheet realm.

entries.subject: Cosmos presentation host
entries.behavior: Own one semantic Document, Canvas, Engine Renderer and Space for the Cosmos main plane and dock HUD projection.

entries.subject: Journal plane
entries.behavior: Present the journal root from the shared Experience Document on a stable resizable plane with capture and diagnostics.

entries.subject: Demo presentation host
entries.behavior: Own one semantic Document, Canvas, Engine Renderer and Space for every Demo projection root.

entries.subject: Journal diagnostics
entries.behavior: Observe neutral plane/frame diagnostics without reaching into retained Engine/WebGPU owner objects.

entries.subject: Journal document
entries.behavior: Render journal images with object-fit, explicit dimensions, retained texture readiness and cleanup.

entries.subject: Compiled UI migration
entries.behavior: Compile linked .tsx component exports through the Template JSX profile instead of importing removed imperative controllers.

entries.subject: Compiled web UI migration
entries.behavior: Configure JSX compilation and migrate stale create*Controller imports to compiled component roots.

entries.subject: Compiled dock migration
entries.behavior: Compile linked .tsx component exports and remove stale imperative createButton usage without restoring legacy APIs.

entries.subject: Matter source parser
entries.behavior: Parse the bounded meta/log/conditional/map source contract without treating ordinary HTML as executable DOM UI.
